localizedValues.name: HB27
localizedValues.description:
This first come first serve site is designated as a walk-in, bicycle-in site. Campers with vehicles are not allowed to occupy site.
Campers should expect to hear some highway noise from nearby highway 97.

localizedValues.name: WT1
localizedValues.description:
This no-frills 12’ X 14’ canvas wall tent has a platform, but does not include furniture or electricity. No cooking or flames in the wall tents.
Campers should expect to hear some highway noise from nearby highway 97.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
G1 accommodates tents and up to six RVs/trailers. The camp has a CXT/Vault Toilet, large open field, and one campfire pit with grate. Electricity and sewer are not available. The dump station is located across the highway in the main park.
Campers should expect to hear some highway noise from nearby highway 97.
This group camp allows equestrian use and has two steel horse corrals.
